_note: Schematic pathway drawn after textbook figures. No measured values. Layout is in SVG units (viewBox). Each node can cite a verified source and link to another site key.

summary.en: Electrons from NADH and succinate pass through complexes I to IV in the inner mitochondrial membrane. Complexes I, III and IV pump protons into the intermembrane space, and ATP synthase uses the returning protons to make ATP.
summary.zh-Hant: NADH 與琥珀酸的電子經內膜上的複合體 I 至 IV 傳遞。複合體 I、III、IV 把質子泵入膜間腔，ATP 合酶利用回流的質子合成 ATP。

text.en: Intermembrane space
text.zh-Hant: 膜間腔

text.en: Matrix
text.zh-Hant: 基質

text.en: Inner membrane
text.zh-Hant: 內膜

text.en: NADH
text.zh-Hant: NADH

text.en: Succinate
text.zh-Hant: 琥珀酸

text.en: ½ O₂ → H₂O
text.zh-Hant: ½ O₂ → H₂O

text.en: ADP + Pi → ATP
text.zh-Hant: ADP + Pi → ATP

text.en: Takes electrons from NADH and passes them on to coenzyme Q. The energy released is used to pump protons from the matrix into the intermembrane space. The human structure is PDB 5XTD.
text.zh-Hant: 接收 NADH 的電子並傳給輔酶 Q，釋出的能量用於把質子由基質泵入膜間腔。人類結構為 PDB 5XTD。

text.en: One of the four multimeric enzymes of the chain. It passes electrons from succinate to coenzyme Q and, unlike complexes I, III and IV, does not pump protons.
text.zh-Hant: 電子傳遞鏈四個多聚體酶之一，把琥珀酸的電子傳給輔酶 Q。與複合體 I、III、IV 不同，它不泵質子。

text.en: A mobile electron carrier that moves within the inner membrane. It carries electrons from complexes I and II to complex III.
text.zh-Hant: 在內膜內移動的電子載體，把複合體 I 與 II 的電子運到複合體 III。

text.en: Takes electrons from coenzyme Q and passes them to cytochrome c. It also pumps protons into the intermembrane space.
text.zh-Hant: 接收輔酶 Q 的電子並傳給細胞色素 c，同時把質子泵入膜間腔。

text.en: A small mobile electron carrier in the intermembrane space. It carries electrons from complex III to complex IV.
text.zh-Hant: 膜間腔內的小型移動電子載體，把複合體 III 的電子運到複合體 IV。

sub.zh-Hant: 細胞色素 c 氧化酶

text.en: Passes electrons from cytochrome c to oxygen and reduces the oxygen to water. The electron transfer is coupled to proton translocation across the membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 把細胞色素 c 的電子傳給氧，並把氧還原成水。電子傳遞與質子跨膜轉運偶聯。

text.en: F1 sits in the matrix and Fo in the inner membrane. Protons flow back through it from the intermembrane space, and the energy of this proton gradient drives the phosphorylation of ADP to ATP.
text.zh-Hant: F1 位於基質，Fo 位於內膜。質子由膜間腔經它流回基質，此質子梯度的能量驅動 ADP 磷酸化成 ATP。

name.en: Digestion and absorption in the small intestine

summary.en: Carbohydrate, protein and fat are digested in the lumen and at the brush border, taken up by enterocytes, and leave through the basolateral side. Sugars and amino acids enter the blood capillary and go to the liver. Fat leaves as chylomicrons into the lacteal.
summary.zh-Hant: 碳水化合物、蛋白質與脂肪在腸腔及刷狀緣被消化，由腸細胞吸收，再從基底外側離開。糖與胺基酸進入血液微血管並運往肝臟，脂肪則以乳糜微粒形式進入乳糜管。

text.en: The absorptive epithelial cell of the small intestine. Its apical brush border faces the lumen, and its basolateral membrane faces the lamina propria. Nutrients cross the cell and leave through the basolateral side.
text.zh-Hant: 小腸的吸收性上皮細胞。頂端的刷狀緣面向腸腔，基底外側膜面向固有層。養分穿過細胞，由基底外側離開。

text.en: Salivary and pancreatic amylases digest starch in the lumen into smaller sugars.
text.zh-Hant: 唾液與胰澱粉酶在腸腔內把澱粉消化成較小的糖。

text.en: Enzymes of the brush border membrane split disaccharides such as lactose and sucrose into monosaccharides (glucose, galactose, fructose) right at the cell surface.
text.zh-Hant: 刷狀緣膜上的酶在細胞表面把乳糖、蔗糖等雙糖分解成單糖（葡萄糖、半乳糖、果糖）。

text.en: Sodium-glucose cotransporter in the apical membrane. It takes up glucose and galactose together with sodium, and it accounts for most dietary glucose uptake in the intestine. Mutations cause glucose/galactose malabsorption.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端膜上的鈉-葡萄糖共轉運蛋白，與鈉一併攝入葡萄糖與半乳糖，負責腸道大部分膳食葡萄糖吸收。突變會導致葡萄糖／半乳糖吸收不良。

text.en: Apical uniporter for fructose. It moves fructose into the cell down its concentration gradient, without sodium.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端膜上的果糖單向轉運蛋白，順濃度梯度把果糖運入細胞，不需要鈉。

text.en: Basolateral uniporter that lets glucose, galactose and fructose leave the cell down their gradients. The sugars then enter the capillary.
text.zh-Hant: 基底外側的單向轉運蛋白，讓葡萄糖、半乳糖與果糖順梯度離開細胞，再進入微血管。

text.en: Basolateral pump that keeps intracellular sodium low. The sodium gradient it maintains drives sodium-coupled uptake by SGLT1.
text.zh-Hant: 基底外側的泵，維持細胞內低鈉。它維持的鈉梯度驅動 SGLT1 的鈉偶聯攝取。

text.en: Gastric and pancreatic proteases cut dietary protein into peptides in the lumen.
text.zh-Hant: 胃與胰蛋白酶在腸腔內把膳食蛋白質切成肽。

text.en: Peptidases on the brush border shorten peptides to amino acids and to di- and tripeptides, the forms the enterocyte takes up.
text.zh-Hant: 刷狀緣上的肽酶把肽縮短成胺基酸及二肽、三肽，即腸細胞攝取的形式。

text.en: Proton-coupled symporter for di- and tripeptides. It is the main route for peptide uptake and absorbs the products of dietary protein digestion in the intestine.
text.zh-Hant: 二肽與三肽的質子偶聯同向轉運蛋白，是肽攝取的主要途徑，負責吸收腸道內膳食蛋白質的消化產物。

text.en: Apical transporters for free amino acids. Amino acids enter the cell this way as well as inside peptides.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端膜上的游離胺基酸轉運蛋白。胺基酸可經此進入細胞，亦可以肽的形式進入。

text.en: Most di- and tripeptides are hydrolysed to amino acids in the cytosol. Some can cross the basolateral membrane intact.
text.zh-Hant: 大部分二肽與三肽在細胞質內水解成胺基酸，部分可完整穿過基底外側膜。

text.en: Basolateral transporters that release amino acids toward the capillary, which carries them into the hepatic portal system.
text.zh-Hant: 基底外側的轉運蛋白，把胺基酸釋向微血管，再經肝門脈系統運走。

sub.zh-Hant: 脂肪 → 單酸甘油酯 + 脂肪酸

text.en: Bile emulsifies dietary fat and pancreatic lipase hydrolyses triglyceride into fatty acids and monoglycerides.
text.zh-Hant: 膽汁把膳食脂肪乳化，胰脂肪酶把三酸甘油酯水解成脂肪酸與單酸甘油酯。

text.en: Bile salts gather the hydrolysis products into micelles, which carry the water-insoluble lipids to the brush border.
text.zh-Hant: 膽鹽把水解產物聚成微胞，把不溶於水的脂質運到刷狀緣。

text.en: Fatty acids enter the enterocyte by protein-mediated and protein-independent processes. Fatty acid transporters on the apical membrane dominate.
text.zh-Hant: 脂肪酸經由蛋白介導與非蛋白介導的過程進入腸細胞，以頂端膜上的脂肪酸轉運蛋白為主。

text.en: Fatty acids and monoglycerides reach the endoplasmic reticulum and are resynthesised into neutral lipids, then used to build lipoproteins with apoB and MTP.
text.zh-Hant: 脂肪酸與單酸甘油酯進入內質網，重新合成中性脂質，再與 apoB 及 MTP 組裝成脂蛋白。

text.en: Lipoproteins are packaged for secretion from the basolateral side of the enterocyte.
text.zh-Hant: 脂蛋白被包裝，由腸細胞的基底外側分泌。

text.en: Large apoB-containing lipoprotein particle. Enterocytes secrete chylomicrons from the basolateral side, and they export dietary fat into the lymphatic system.
text.zh-Hant: 含 apoB 的大型脂蛋白顆粒。腸細胞由基底外側分泌乳糜微粒，把膳食脂肪輸出至淋巴系統。

sub.en: blood vessel, to the hepatic portal vein

text.en: Blood capillary of the lamina propria. It takes up sugars and amino acids from the enterocyte and carries them to the liver by the hepatic portal system.
text.zh-Hant: 固有層的血液微血管，從腸細胞吸收糖與胺基酸，經肝門脈系統運往肝臟。

text.en: Lymphatic capillary in the core of the villus. Chylomicrons are too large to enter blood capillaries, so they pass into the lacteal and travel in lymph.
text.zh-Hant: 絨毛中央的淋巴微管。乳糜微粒太大，無法進入血液微血管，故進入乳糜管並隨淋巴運行。

name.zh-Hant: 細胞凋亡：外在與內在途徑

summary.en: The extrinsic pathway starts at a death receptor, forms the DISC and activates caspase-8. The intrinsic pathway starts with cell stress, is controlled by the BCL-2 family at the mitochondrion, and releases cytochrome c to activate caspase-9. Both pathways meet at the executioner caspases.
summary.zh-Hant: 外在途徑由死亡受體開始，形成 DISC 並活化 caspase-8。內在途徑由細胞壓力開始，在線粒體受 BCL-2 家族控制，釋出細胞色素 c 以活化 caspase-9。兩條途徑在執行型 caspase 匯合。

text.en: Extracellular
text.zh-Hant: 細胞外

text.en: Plasma membrane
text.zh-Hant: 細胞膜

text.en: Extrinsic pathway
text.zh-Hant: 外在途徑

text.en: Intrinsic pathway
text.zh-Hant: 內在途徑

text.en: cleaves BID
text.zh-Hant: 切割 BID

text.en: tBID
text.zh-Hant: tBID

text.en: type I cells: direct
text.zh-Hant: I 型細胞：直接

text.en: cleavage of caspase-3
text.zh-Hant: 切割 caspase-3

text.en: The BCL-2 family controls the outer membrane of the mitochondrion. When it is permeabilised (MOMP), proteins from the intermembrane space such as cytochrome c and SMAC are released into the cytosol.
text.zh-Hant: BCL-2 家族控制線粒體外膜。外膜通透化（MOMP）後，膜間腔的蛋白質如細胞色素 c 與 SMAC 會釋入細胞質。

text.en: An extracellular signal that starts the extrinsic pathway. Death ligands such as FasL bind their receptors on the target cell.
text.zh-Hant: 啟動外在途徑的細胞外訊號。FasL 等死亡配體與目標細胞上的受體結合。

text.en: A member of the death receptor family in the plasma membrane. When the ligand binds, it recruits the adaptor FADD.
text.zh-Hant: 位於細胞膜的死亡受體家族成員。配體結合後，它招募接合蛋白 FADD。

text.en: The adaptor FADD and initiator procaspase-8 are recruited to the receptor and form the death-inducing signaling complex (DISC). Procaspase-8 is activated there by cleavage.
text.zh-Hant: 接合蛋白 FADD 與啟動型前 caspase-8 被招募到受體，形成死亡誘導訊號複合體（DISC），前 caspase-8 在此經切割而活化。

text.en: Active caspase-8 is released from the DISC. In type I cells it cleaves caspase-3 directly. In type II cells it cleaves BID and so engages the mitochondrial branch.
text.zh-Hant: 活性 caspase-8 由 DISC 釋出。在 I 型細胞中它直接切割 caspase-3；在 II 型細胞中它切割 BID，從而啟動線粒體分支。

text.en: Caspase-8 cleaves BID to tBID, a BH3-only protein. This links the extrinsic pathway to the mitochondria in type II cells, and Bcl-2 or Bcl-xL can block it.
text.zh-Hant: Caspase-8 把 BID 切割成 tBID（僅含 BH3 的蛋白），在 II 型細胞中把外在途徑連到線粒體，而 Bcl-2 或 Bcl-xL 可阻斷。

sub.zh-Hant: DNA 損傷、缺乏生長因子

text.en: Signals from inside the cell, such as DNA damage or loss of growth factors, start the intrinsic (mitochondrial) pathway.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞內部的訊號，例如 DNA 損傷或缺乏生長因子，啟動內在（線粒體）途徑。

text.en: Sensors of stress in the BCL-2 family. They engage BAX and BAK and neutralise anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins, and both actions help trigger MOMP.
text.zh-Hant: BCL-2 家族中感應壓力的蛋白，啟動 BAX 與 BAK 並中和抗凋亡的 BCL-2 蛋白，兩者都有助觸發 MOMP。

text.en: Anti-apoptotic members of the BCL-2 family. They hold back BAX and BAK and are neutralised by BH3-only proteins. Structures in the atlas: BCL-2 (1G5M), BCL-XL (1MAZ) and MCL-1 with a Bim BH3 peptide (2PQK).
text.zh-Hant: BCL-2 家族的抗凋亡成員，抑制 BAX 與 BAK，並被僅含 BH3 的蛋白中和。圖譜內的結構：BCL-2（1G5M）、BCL-XL（1MAZ）及與 Bim BH3 肽結合的 MCL-1（2PQK）。

text.en: Pro-apoptotic effectors that permeabilise the outer mitochondrial membrane. Structures in the atlas: BAX (1F16) and BAK (2IMS).
text.zh-Hant: 使線粒體外膜通透化的促凋亡效應蛋白。圖譜內的結構：BAX（1F16）及 BAK（2IMS）。

text.en: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, the point of no return of the intrinsic pathway. It releases cytochrome c and other intermembrane space proteins.
text.zh-Hant: 線粒體外膜通透化，是內在途徑的不歸點，釋出細胞色素 c 及其他膜間腔蛋白。

text.en: In healthy cells it shuttles electrons in the respiratory chain. Released into the cytosol, it activates Apaf-1.
text.zh-Hant: 在健康細胞中它在呼吸鏈中傳遞電子；釋入細胞質後，它活化 Apaf-1。

text.en: The Apaf-1 apoptosome is the adaptor complex that activates the initiator caspase-9.
text.zh-Hant: Apaf-1 凋亡體是活化啟動型 caspase-9 的接合蛋白複合體。

text.en: Initiator caspase of the intrinsic pathway. Once activated on the apoptosome it matures caspase-3.
text.zh-Hant: 內在途徑的啟動型 caspase，在凋亡體上活化後使 caspase-3 成熟。

text.en: Both pathways meet here. Executioner caspases are cleaved and activated by initiator caspases, and they cleave hundreds of cell proteins.
text.zh-Hant: 兩條途徑在此匯合。執行型 caspase 被啟動型 caspase 切割而活化，並切割數以百計的細胞蛋白。

sub.zh-Hant: 起泡、DNA 斷裂、凋亡小體

text.en: Apoptosis ends with characteristic morphological changes and energy-dependent biochemical events. The cell is cleared with little damage to its surroundings.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞凋亡以特徵性的形態改變及耗能的生化事件完結，細胞被清除，對周圍組織損害極小。

name.en: Cellular respiration: glycolysis and the TCA cycle
name.zh-Hant: 細胞呼吸：糖解與 TCA 循環

summary.en: Glycolysis in the cytosol turns one glucose into two pyruvate, with a net 2 ATP and 2 NADH. Pyruvate enters the mitochondrial matrix, where the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex makes acetyl-CoA and the TCA cycle oxidises it. The NADH and FADH₂ made on the way go to the electron transport chain.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞質內的糖解把一個葡萄糖變成兩個丙酮酸，淨得 2 個 ATP 與 2 個 NADH。丙酮酸進入線粒體基質，由丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體製成乙醯輔酶 A，再由 TCA 循環氧化。過程中產生的 NADH 與 FADH₂ 送往電子傳遞鏈。

text.en: enters the matrix
text.zh-Hant: 進入基質

text.en: net: 2 ATP + 2 NADH
text.zh-Hant: 淨得：2 ATP + 2 NADH

text.en: per glucose
text.zh-Hant: 每個葡萄糖

text.en: TCA cycle
text.zh-Hant: TCA 循環

text.en: CO₂, NADH
text.zh-Hant: CO₂、NADH

text.en: CO₂, NADH
text.zh-Hant: CO₂、NADH

text.en: GTP / ATP
text.zh-Hant: GTP / ATP

text.en: FADH₂
text.zh-Hant: FADH₂

text.en: NADH
text.zh-Hant: NADH

label.zh-Hant: 乙醯輔酶 A 與 TCA 循環

text.en: Glycolysis takes place in the cytosol and does not need oxygen. It turns one glucose into two pyruvate.
text.zh-Hant: 糖解在細胞質進行，不需要氧氣，把一個葡萄糖變成兩個丙酮酸。

text.en: Pyruvate oxidation and the TCA cycle take place in the matrix. Pyruvate is transported into the mitochondrion before it is oxidised.
text.zh-Hant: 丙酮酸氧化與 TCA 循環在基質進行。丙酮酸先運入線粒體，才被氧化。

text.en: The fuel of glycolysis. Glucose enters the cell and is trapped there by phosphorylation, which is the first step of glycolysis.
text.zh-Hant: 糖解的燃料。葡萄糖進入細胞後經磷酸化被困在細胞內，這是糖解的第一步。

text.en: Hexokinase and phosphofructokinase-1 each add a phosphate from ATP, so the investment phase uses 2 ATP. 2-deoxyglucose blocks hexokinase.
text.zh-Hant: 己糖激酶與磷酸果糖激酶-1 各自從 ATP 取得一個磷酸，因此投入期消耗 2 個 ATP。2-脫氧葡萄糖會阻斷己糖激酶。

text.en: A six-carbon sugar with two phosphates. It is the product of the investment phase.
text.zh-Hant: 帶兩個磷酸的六碳糖，是投入期的產物。

text.en: Aldolase splits the six-carbon sugar into two three-carbon sugars, so everything after this step happens twice per glucose.
text.zh-Hant: 醛縮酶把六碳糖分成兩個三碳糖，因此之後每一步每個葡萄糖都發生兩次。

text.en: The three-carbon sugar that enters the payoff phase. Two molecules form from each glucose.
text.zh-Hant: 進入回報期的三碳糖，每個葡萄糖產生兩個分子。

text.en: Glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase reduces NAD⁺ to NADH. Two NADH form per glucose. Several steps between this one and pyruvate kinase are not drawn.
text.zh-Hant: 甘油醛 3-磷酸脫氫酶把 NAD⁺ 還原成 NADH，每個葡萄糖產生 2 個 NADH。此步與丙酮酸激酶之間的數步沒有畫出。

text.en: The payoff phase makes 4 ATP per glucose. Subtracting the 2 ATP spent earlier, glycolysis nets 2 ATP.
text.zh-Hant: 回報期每個葡萄糖產生 4 個 ATP，減去先前消耗的 2 個，糖解淨得 2 個 ATP。

text.en: The end product of glycolysis. It is transported into mitochondria through the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier as the fuel input of the citric acid cycle. Without oxygen it is reduced to lactate instead.
text.zh-Hant: 糖解的終產物，經線粒體丙酮酸載體運入線粒體，作為檸檬酸循環的燃料。缺氧時它會改為還原成乳酸。

sub.zh-Hant: 丙酮酸 → 乙醯輔酶 A + CO₂ + NADH

text.en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex links glycolysis to the Krebs cycle. It decarboxylates pyruvate into acetyl-CoA irreversibly, and is regulated by phosphorylation (PDK and PDP).
text.zh-Hant: 丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體連接糖解與克雷布斯循環，把丙酮酸不可逆地脫羧成乙醯輔酶 A，並受磷酸化（PDK 與 PDP）調控。

text.en: The two-carbon fuel of the TCA cycle. It joins oxaloacetate to make citrate.
text.zh-Hant: TCA 循環的二碳燃料，與草醯乙酸結合成檸檬酸。

text.en: Formed from acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate. The first step of the TCA cycle.
text.zh-Hant: 由乙醯輔酶 A 與草醯乙酸生成，是 TCA 循環的第一步。

text.en: An isomer of citrate. The cycle then removes carbon from it.
text.zh-Hant: 檸檬酸的異構物，循環其後從它移走碳。

text.en: Five-carbon intermediate. Its formation from isocitrate releases CO₂ and makes NADH.
text.zh-Hant: 五碳中間物，由異檸檬酸生成時釋出 CO₂ 並產生 NADH。

text.en: Four-carbon intermediate. Its formation from α-ketoglutarate releases a second CO₂ and makes NADH.
text.zh-Hant: 四碳中間物，由 α-酮戊二酸生成時釋出第二個 CO₂ 並產生 NADH。

text.en: Formed from succinyl-CoA with the release of GTP or ATP.
text.zh-Hant: 由琥珀醯輔酶 A 生成，並釋出 GTP 或 ATP。

text.en: Formed from succinate. This step makes FADH₂.
text.zh-Hant: 由琥珀酸生成，此步產生 FADH₂。

text.en: Formed from fumarate by adding water.
text.zh-Hant: 由延胡索酸加水生成。

text.en: Made from malate with NADH. It condenses with acetyl-CoA to start the next turn, so the cycle regenerates its own starting molecule.
text.zh-Hant: 由蘋果酸生成並產生 NADH。它與乙醯輔酶 A 縮合，開始下一圈，因此循環會重新生成起始分子。

text.en: Glycolysis, pyruvate oxidation and the TCA cycle load electron carriers with electrons. The respiratory chain reoxidises them and makes ATP. See the electron transport chain diagram.
text.zh-Hant: 糖解、丙酮酸氧化與 TCA 循環把電子載入電子載體，呼吸鏈再把它們氧化並製造 ATP。見電子傳遞鏈圖解。

name.zh-Hant: 蛋白質合成：轉錄與轉譯

summary.en: In the nucleus RNA polymerase II copies a gene into pre-mRNA, which is cleaved at the poly(A) signal, capped, spliced and tailed to make a mature mRNA. The mRNA leaves through a nuclear pore, and in the cytosol the ribosome reads it in three stages: initiation, elongation and termination.
summary.zh-Hant: 在細胞核中，RNA 聚合酶 II 把基因複製成前 mRNA，前 mRNA 在 poly(A) 訊號處被切開，再經加帽、剪接與加尾成為成熟 mRNA。mRNA 經核孔離開，在細胞質中由核糖體分起始、延伸與終止三個階段讀取。

text.en: export through the nuclear pore
text.zh-Hant: 經核孔輸出

text.en: Translation
text.zh-Hant: 轉譯

text.en: Transcription
text.zh-Hant: 轉錄

text.en: Transcription and RNA processing take place in the nucleus. The product is a mature mRNA.
text.zh-Hant: 轉錄與 RNA 加工在細胞核進行，產物是成熟的 mRNA。

text.en: Translation takes place on ribosomes in the cytosol (and on the rough endoplasmic reticulum for secreted and membrane proteins).
text.zh-Hant: 轉譯在細胞質的核糖體進行（分泌蛋白與膜蛋白則在粗面內質網上）。

text.en: A gene is a stretch of DNA from the promoter to the terminator. RNA polymerase reads the template strand and makes an RNA copy.
text.zh-Hant: 基因是由啟動子至終止子的一段 DNA。RNA 聚合酶讀取模板股並製成 RNA 副本。

sub.en: Pol II + factors at the promoter
sub.zh-Hant: Pol II 與因子結合啟動子

text.en: RNA polymerase II and general transcription factors assemble at the promoter and start RNA synthesis. After initiation, Pol II pauses near the promoter until it receives a signal to continue.
text.zh-Hant: RNA 聚合酶 II 與一般轉錄因子在啟動子組裝並開始合成 RNA。起始後 Pol II 在啟動子附近暫停，直至收到繼續的訊號。

sub.zh-Hant: 前 mRNA 由 5′ 向 3′ 合成

text.en: P-TEFb releases paused Pol II into productive elongation. The polymerase adds nucleotides along the template and makes a full-length pre-mRNA that is processed as it is made.
text.zh-Hant: P-TEFb 令暫停的 Pol II 進入有效延伸。聚合酶沿模板加入核苷酸，產生完整的前 mRNA，並邊合成邊加工。

sub.zh-Hant: 在 poly(A) 訊號處切開

text.en: At the end of the gene the transcript is cleaved at the poly(A) signal, which releases the messenger RNA. The remaining RNA is degraded, and this triggers Pol II to stop.
text.zh-Hant: 在基因末端，轉錄本於 poly(A) 訊號處被切開，釋出信使 RNA。其餘 RNA 被降解，並促使 Pol II 停止。

text.en: The pre-mRNA gets a 5′ cap, introns are spliced out, and a poly(A) tail is added. Splicing can be alternative, so one gene can give several mRNAs. Processing is coupled to transcription through the Pol II CTD.
text.zh-Hant: 前 mRNA 加上 5′ 帽，內含子被剪除，並加上 poly(A) 尾。剪接可以是選擇性的，因此一個基因可產生多種 mRNA。加工透過 Pol II 的 CTD 與轉錄偶聯。

text.en: A mature eukaryotic mRNA is monocistronic: a 5′ cap, a 5′ untranslated region, one coding region and a longer 3′ untranslated region. It leaves the nucleus through a nuclear pore.
text.zh-Hant: 成熟的真核 mRNA 為單順反子：5′ 帽、5′ 非轉譯區、一個編碼區及較長的 3′ 非轉譯區，經核孔離開細胞核。

text.en: The polymerase that makes all mRNA. It has 12 polypeptides, and the largest, Rpb1, carries the C-terminal domain (CTD), whose phosphorylation state coordinates transcription and RNA processing.
text.zh-Hant: 製造所有 mRNA 的聚合酶，有 12 個多肽，最大的 Rpb1 帶有 C 端結構域（CTD），其磷酸化狀態協調轉錄與 RNA 加工。

text.en: The cap-binding complex eIF4F recognises the 5′ cap. The 43S complex (40S subunit, eIF2·GTP·Met-tRNAi and eIF3) then binds the mRNA at its 5′ end.
text.zh-Hant: 帽結合複合體 eIF4F 辨認 5′ 帽，43S 複合體（40S 次單位、eIF2·GTP·Met-tRNAi 與 eIF3）隨後結合 mRNA 的 5′ 端。

text.en: The bound complex scans along the 5′ untranslated region to the initiation codon, where the codon pairs with the anticodon of the initiator tRNA. This is the 48S initiation complex.
text.zh-Hant: 結合的複合體沿 5′ 非轉譯區掃描至起始密碼子，密碼子與起始 tRNA 的反密碼子配對，形成 48S 起始複合體。

text.en: The 60S subunit joins with the help of eIF5B and forms the 80S ribosome, with Met-tRNAi in the P site at the start codon. The atlas has a structure of the human 80S ribosome (4UG0).
text.zh-Hant: 60S 次單位在 eIF5B 協助下加入，形成 80S 核糖體，Met-tRNAi 位於起始密碼子的 P 位。圖譜內有人類 80S 核糖體的結構（4UG0）。

sub.zh-Hant: tRNA 進入、形成肽鍵、移位

text.en: Aminoacyl-tRNAs that match the codon enter the ribosome, the ribosome forms a peptide bond, and the ribosome moves one codon along the mRNA. The cycle repeats and the polypeptide grows.
text.zh-Hant: 與密碼子配對的氨酰 tRNA 進入核糖體，核糖體形成肽鍵並沿 mRNA 移動一個密碼子。這個循環重複，多肽鏈便延長。

text.en: When a stop codon reaches the ribosome, release factors release the finished polypeptide. The ribosome is then recycled.
text.zh-Hant: 終止密碼子到達核糖體時，釋放因子把完成的多肽鏈釋出，核糖體隨後被回收。

text.en: The polypeptide folds into its three-dimensional structure and may be modified, then goes to its place in the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 多肽摺疊成三維結構，可能被修飾，然後前往它在細胞內的位置。

text.en: Translation initiation needs at least 12 initiation factors. Protein synthesis is mainly regulated at initiation, so these factors and the pathways that control them are central targets of regulation.
text.zh-Hant: 轉譯起始需要至少 12 個起始因子。蛋白質合成主要在起始階段受調控，因此這些因子及控制它們的途徑是主要的調控目標。

text.en: Each tRNA carries an amino acid and reads one mRNA codon with its anticodon. This is how the nucleotide sequence is translated into an amino acid sequence.
text.zh-Hant: 每個 tRNA 攜帶一個胺基酸，以反密碼子讀取 mRNA 的一個密碼子，核苷酸序列因此被轉譯成胺基酸序列。

text.en: Release factors recognise the stop codon and release the polypeptide from the last tRNA.
text.zh-Hant: 釋放因子辨認終止密碼子，把多肽鏈從最後的 tRNA 釋出。

name.zh-Hant: 腎上腺素受體訊號傳遞

summary.en: Norepinephrine and epinephrine bind three classes of adrenergic receptor. α1 couples to Gq/11 and raises Ca²⁺ and PKC, α2 couples to Gi/o and lowers cAMP, and β couples to Gs and raises cAMP and PKA. After activation, GRK and β-arrestin end the G protein signal and start internalisation and G protein-independent signalling.
summary.zh-Hant: 去甲腎上腺素與腎上腺素結合三類腎上腺素受體。α1 偶聯 Gq/11，使 Ca²⁺ 與 PKC 上升；α2 偶聯 Gi/o，使 cAMP 下降；β 偶聯 Gs，使 cAMP 與 PKA 上升。受體活化後，GRK 與 β-arrestin 終止 G 蛋白訊號，並啟動內吞及不依賴 G 蛋白的訊號。

text.en: Extracellular
text.zh-Hant: 細胞外

text.en: Membrane
text.zh-Hant: 細胞膜

name.zh-Hant: 去甲腎上腺素、腎上腺素

text.en: The sympathetic signals. Both catecholamines bind adrenergic receptors on the surface of target cells, and the receptor subtype decides which pathway the cell uses.
text.zh-Hant: 交感神經的訊號。兩種兒茶酚胺都結合目標細胞表面的腎上腺素受體，受體亞型決定細胞使用哪條途徑。

text.en: The α1 class of adrenergic receptors has three subtypes. It is a G protein-coupled receptor that couples to Gq/11.
text.zh-Hant: 腎上腺素受體的 α1 類有三個亞型，是偶聯 Gq/11 的 G 蛋白偶聯受體。

text.en: The α2 class has three subtypes and couples to Gi/o. It lowers cAMP, and its effects include blood pressure control and sedation.
text.zh-Hant: α2 類有三個亞型，偶聯 Gi/o，使 cAMP 下降，作用包括調節血壓與鎮靜。

text.en: The β class has three subtypes (β1, β2, β3) and couples to Gs. In the heart β1 is mainly responsible for positive chronotropic and inotropic effects. The β2 receptor is the model for GPCR activation, and its structure with Gs is in the atlas (3SN6).
text.zh-Hant: β 類有三個亞型（β1、β2、β3），偶聯 Gs。在心臟，β1 主要負責正性變時與變力作用。β2 受體是 GPCR 活化的模型，圖譜內有其與 Gs 的複合體結構（3SN6）。

text.en: The G protein of α1 receptors. It activates phospholipase C.
text.zh-Hant: α1 受體的 G 蛋白，活化磷脂酶 C。

text.en: Cleaves a membrane phospholipid into IP₃ and DAG.
text.zh-Hant: 把膜磷脂切成 IP₃ 與 DAG。

text.en: IP₃ releases Ca²⁺ from internal stores, and DAG activates protein kinase C.
text.zh-Hant: IP₃ 使內部貯存的 Ca²⁺ 釋出，DAG 則活化蛋白激酶 C。

text.en: Raised intracellular Ca²⁺ and PKC are the main α1 outputs. α1 receptors are also linked to MAPK, phospholipase D, arachidonic acid release and, in some cells, PI3K and Ras.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞內 Ca²⁺ 上升與 PKC 是 α1 的主要輸出。α1 受體亦與 MAPK、磷脂酶 D、花生四烯酸釋出相關，在某些細胞還涉及 PI3K 與 Ras。

text.en: The G protein of α2 receptors. Its α subunit inhibits adenylyl cyclase, and its βγ subunits act on ion channels.
text.zh-Hant: α2 受體的 G 蛋白，α 次單位抑制腺苷酸環化酶，βγ 次單位作用於離子通道。

text.en: The enzyme that makes cAMP from ATP. Gi/o inhibits it.
text.zh-Hant: 由 ATP 製造 cAMP 的酶，Gi/o 抑制它。

text.en: Less adenylyl cyclase activity lowers cAMP, which opposes β receptor signalling in the same cell.
text.zh-Hant: 腺苷酸環化酶活性下降使 cAMP 減少，與同一細胞的 β 受體訊號相反。

sub.en: K⁺ channels open, Ca²⁺ channels close
sub.zh-Hant: K⁺ 通道開啟、Ca²⁺ 通道關閉

text.en: The βγ subunits released from Gi/o activate K⁺ channels and inhibit Ca²⁺ channels. In some cells they also activate PLCβ and MAPK.
text.zh-Hant: 由 Gi/o 釋出的 βγ 次單位活化 K⁺ 通道並抑制 Ca²⁺ 通道，在某些細胞還活化 PLCβ 與 MAPK。

text.en: The stimulatory G protein of β receptors. It activates adenylyl cyclase.
text.zh-Hant: β 受體的刺激型 G 蛋白，活化腺苷酸環化酶。

text.en: Gs stimulates adenylyl cyclase to make cAMP from ATP.
text.zh-Hant: Gs 刺激腺苷酸環化酶，由 ATP 製造 cAMP。

text.en: Raised cAMP is the main β second messenger.
text.zh-Hant: cAMP 上升是 β 受體的主要第二信使。

text.en: cAMP activates protein kinase A and EPAC. PKA can also phosphorylate the β2 receptor itself and switch its coupling from Gs to Gi, which sends signals to MAP kinase through Gβγ, Src and Ras.
text.zh-Hant: cAMP 活化蛋白激酶 A 與 EPAC。PKA 也可磷酸化 β2 受體本身，使其由偶聯 Gs 轉為偶聯 Gi，經 Gβγ、Src 與 Ras 把訊號送往 MAP 激酶。

text.en: Downstream effects include gene transcription through CREB and changes in Ca²⁺ handling. In some contexts ERK/MAPK and AKT are also engaged.
text.zh-Hant: 下游作用包括經 CREB 的基因轉錄及 Ca²⁺ 處理的改變，在某些情況下亦涉及 ERK/MAPK 與 AKT。

text.en: After activation the receptor is phosphorylated by a G protein-coupled receptor kinase, and β-arrestin binds it. β-arrestin blocks further G protein signalling.
text.zh-Hant: 受體活化後被 G 蛋白偶聯受體激酶磷酸化，β-arrestin 隨即結合，並阻斷進一步的 G 蛋白訊號。

text.en: β-arrestin binds clathrin and acts as an adaptor in endocytosis of the β2 receptor, which ends the surface signal (desensitisation).
text.zh-Hant: β-arrestin 結合網格蛋白，作為 β2 受體內吞的接合蛋白，使表面訊號終止（脫敏）。

text.en: β-arrestins are not only brakes. They also promote alternate downstream signalling, such as MAPK, that does not depend on G proteins.
text.zh-Hant: β-arrestin 不只是煞車，它也促進不依賴 G 蛋白的其他下游訊號，例如 MAPK。

name.en: Electron flow through the respiratory chain, centre by centre
name.zh-Hant: 呼吸鏈中電子逐個中心的流動

summary.en: Electrons move through the respiratory complexes along a fixed chain of redox centres: flavin, iron-sulfur clusters, quinone, hemes and copper. In complex I the chain runs FMN, N3, N1b, N4, N5, N6a, N6b and N2, and the distances between neighbouring cofactors measured in PDB 5XTD are 6.7 to 14.8 Å, close to the 14 Å over which electrons tunnel between redox centres. Complexes II, III and IV are drawn by centre order only.
summary.zh-Hant: 電子沿著由氧化還原中心組成的固定鏈穿過各呼吸複合體：黃素、鐵硫簇、醌、血基質與銅。在複合體 I，電子鏈依次為 FMN、N3、N1b、N4、N5、N6a、N6b 與 N2，PDB 5XTD 中相鄰輔因子的距離為 6.7 至 14.8 Å，接近電子在氧化還原中心之間穿隧的 14 Å 範圍。複合體 II、III、IV 只畫出中心的次序。

text.en: Complex I: NADH to ubiquinone. Edge to edge distances between cofactors, measured in PDB 5XTD
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 I：NADH 到泛醌。輔因子之間邊到邊的距離，取自 PDB 5XTD

text.en: Complex II: succinate to ubiquinone
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 II：琥珀酸到泛醌

text.en: Complex III: ubiquinol to cytochrome c (Q cycle)
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 III：泛醇到細胞色素 c（Q 循環）

text.en: Complex IV: cytochrome c to oxygen
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 IV：細胞色素 c 到氧

text.en: 12.2 Å, off the main path
text.zh-Hant: 12.2 Å，不在主路徑上

text.en: low-potential branch
text.zh-Hant: 低電位分支

label.zh-Hant: 氧化還原中心之間的電子路徑

text.en: The electron donor of complex I. NAD is a hydrogen carrier that gives up two electrons together with a proton (a hydride) in one step. The NADH site is not resolved in PDB 5XTD, so no distance to the flavin is given.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 I 的電子供體。NAD 是氫載體，一步放出兩個電子連同一個質子（氫負離子）。PDB 5XTD 沒有解出 NADH 位點，因此不給出它與黃素的距離。

text.en: Flavin mononucleotide takes the two electrons from NADH and passes them on one at a time. Flavins can be reduced in two single-electron steps through a semiquinone radical, which lets the two-electron donor feed a one-electron iron-sulfur chain. In 5XTD it is 6.7 Å (edge to edge) from the first cluster, N3.
text.zh-Hant: 黃素單核苷酸接收 NADH 的兩個電子，再一次傳出一個。黃素可經半醌自由基分兩個單電子步驟還原，使雙電子供體得以供應單電子的鐵硫鏈。在 5XTD 中，它與第一個鐵硫簇 N3 相距 6.7 Å（邊到邊）。

text.en: First iron-sulfur cluster of the chain (NDUFV1). Edge to edge it is 6.7 Å from FMN and 11.4 Å from N1b (centre to centre 13.4 and 14.6 Å, measured in 5XTD). In an iron-sulfur protein the iron is bound to the protein through the sulfur of cysteine, and the cluster carries one electron at a time.
text.zh-Hant: 鏈中第一個鐵硫簇（NDUFV1）。在 5XTD 中，它與 FMN 相距 6.7 Å，與 N1b 相距 11.4 Å（邊到邊；中心到中心為 13.4 與 14.6 Å）。鐵硫蛋白的鐵經半胱胺酸的硫與蛋白結合，簇一次傳遞一個電子。

text.en: A 2Fe–2S cluster (NDUFS1) on the main path. It is 11.4 Å (edge to edge) from N3 and 11.4 Å from N4 in 5XTD.
text.zh-Hant: 主路徑上的 2Fe–2S 簇（NDUFS1）。在 5XTD 中，它與 N3 及 N4 都相距 11.4 Å（邊到邊）。

text.en: A 4Fe–4S cluster (NDUFS1). It is 11.4 Å from N1b and 8.4 Å from N5 in 5XTD (edge to edge).
text.zh-Hant: 4Fe–4S 簇（NDUFS1）。在 5XTD 中，它與 N1b 相距 11.4 Å，與 N5 相距 8.4 Å（邊到邊）。

text.en: A 4Fe–4S cluster (NDUFS1). The next cluster, N6a, is 14.8 Å away (edge to edge), the longest gap on the path and slightly above the 14 Å limit seen in most redox proteins. The model is a 3.7 Å cryo-EM map, so the figure has an error of a few tenths of an ångström.
text.zh-Hant: 4Fe–4S 簇（NDUFS1）。下一個簇 N6a 相距 14.8 Å（邊到邊），是路徑上最長的間隔，略高於多數氧化還原蛋白的 14 Å 上限。此模型來自 3.7 Å 冷凍電鏡圖，數值有零點幾埃的誤差。

text.en: A 4Fe–4S cluster (NDUFS8), the one nearer to N5. It is named N6a here by its position in the chain, because the deposited model does not label which of its two clusters is N6a. It is 8.4 Å from N6b.
text.zh-Hant: 4Fe–4S 簇（NDUFS8），較接近 N5 的一個。由於存檔模型沒有標明兩個簇何者為 N6a，此處按其在鏈中的位置命名。它與 N6b 相距 8.4 Å。

text.en: The second 4Fe–4S cluster of NDUFS8, named by position. It is 8.4 Å from N6a and 10.3 Å from N2.
text.zh-Hant: NDUFS8 的第二個 4Fe–4S 簇，按位置命名。它與 N6a 相距 8.4 Å，與 N2 相距 10.3 Å。

text.en: The last cluster before ubiquinone (NDUFS7 holds it, and the Q-site is formed with NDUFS2). Fe–S centre N2 is the one that hands electrons to ubiquinone.
text.zh-Hant: 鏈上最後一個鐵硫簇，位於泛醌之前（由 NDUFS7 持有，Q 位點與 NDUFS2 共同構成）。鐵硫中心 N2 把電子交給泛醌。

text.en: Ubiquinone is a hydrogen carrier: it takes two electrons in two single-electron steps through a semiquinone, and two protons, to become ubiquinol. Ubiquinol then moves in the membrane. PDB 5XTD holds no quinone, so no distance from N2 is given.
text.zh-Hant: 泛醌是氫載體：它分兩個單電子步驟經半醌接收兩個電子與兩個質子，變成泛醇，再在膜內移動。PDB 5XTD 沒有泛醌，因此不給出它與 N2 的距離。

text.en: A 2Fe–2S cluster (NDUFV2) beside FMN, 12.2 Å away (edge to edge) in 5XTD. It lies off the main path from FMN to N2.
text.zh-Hant: FMN 旁的 2Fe–2S 簇（NDUFV2），在 5XTD 中相距 12.2 Å（邊到邊），不在 FMN 到 N2 的主路徑上。

text.en: The substrate of complex II. This is the same step as in the TCA cycle, so complex II is part of both the cycle and the respiratory chain.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 II 的底物。這一步與 TCA 循環相同，因此複合體 II 同屬 TCA 循環與呼吸鏈。

text.en: The flavin of the flavoprotein subunit takes electrons from succinate. A flavoprotein reduced this way gives electrons on to the iron-sulfur protein.
text.zh-Hant: 黃素蛋白次單位的黃素從琥珀酸接收電子，再傳給鐵硫蛋白。

text.en: First cluster of the iron-sulfur protein subunit. Complex II has three iron-sulfur clusters in a row.
text.zh-Hant: 鐵硫蛋白次單位的第一個簇。複合體 II 有三個依次排列的鐵硫簇。

text.en: Second cluster of the row.
text.zh-Hant: 三個簇中的第二個。

text.en: Third cluster, next to the quinone site in the membrane subunits.
text.zh-Hant: 第三個簇，靠近膜內次單位的泛醌位點。

text.en: Complex II reduces ubiquinone, as complex I does. Complex II does not pump protons.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 II 與複合體 I 一樣還原泛醌。複合體 II 不泵質子。

text.en: Ubiquinol made by complexes I and II is oxidised by complex III. The bc1 complex oxidises ubihydroquinone and reduces cytochrome c through a Q cycle.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 I 與 II 生成的泛醇由複合體 III 氧化。bc1 複合體氧化泛醇並經 Q 循環還原細胞色素 c。

text.en: The 2Fe–2S iron-sulfur protein of complex III. It takes the first electron from ubiquinol and passes it to cytochrome c1.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 III 的 2Fe–2S 鐵硫蛋白。它從泛醇接收第一個電子並傳給細胞色素 c1。

text.en: The covalently bound c-type heme of cytochrome c1. It passes the electron on to soluble cytochrome c.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞色素 c1 以共價結合的 c 型血基質，把電子傳給可溶的細胞色素 c。

text.en: A small soluble protein in the intermembrane space. Its heme iron cycles between Fe³⁺ and Fe²⁺, and it carries one electron at a time from complex III to complex IV.
text.zh-Hant: 膜間腔內的小型可溶蛋白，血基質的鐵在 Fe³⁺ 與 Fe²⁺ 之間轉換，一次把一個電子由複合體 III 帶到複合體 IV。

text.en: Cytochrome b holds two b hemes that differ in their optical and thermodynamic properties. Heme bL takes the second electron from ubiquinol.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞色素 b 含兩個 b 血基質，光學與熱力學性質各異。血基質 bL 從泛醇接收第二個電子。

text.en: The second b heme passes the electron to a ubiquinone at the other quinone site, which is how the Q cycle recycles quinone and builds up the proton gradient.
text.zh-Hant: 第二個 b 血基質把電子傳給另一個泛醌位點的泛醌，Q 循環因此回收泛醌並建立質子梯度。

text.en: Ubiquinone reduced at this site returns to the pool.
text.zh-Hant: 在此位點還原的泛醌回到泛醌池。

text.en: Reduced cytochrome c docks on complex IV and gives it one electron at a time.
text.zh-Hant: 還原型細胞色素 c 停靠在複合體 IV 上，一次交出一個電子。

text.en: The first acceptor in complex IV, a dinuclear copper centre. Copper, as well as iron, is a redox metal in cytochrome oxidase.
text.zh-Hant: 複合體 IV 的第一個電子受體，是雙核銅中心。在細胞色素氧化酶中，銅與鐵都是氧化還原金屬。

text.en: Heme A is anchored in the membrane by its hydrophobic side chain, in cytochromes a and a3, which together form cytochrome oxidase.
text.zh-Hant: 血基質 A 以其疏水側鏈錨定在膜內，存在於細胞色素 a 與 a3，兩者合起來構成細胞色素氧化酶。

text.en: The binuclear site where oxygen binds. Electron transfer here is coupled to proton translocation across the membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 氧結合的雙核位點。這裡的電子傳遞與質子跨膜轉運偶聯。

text.en: The final electron acceptor. Cytochrome oxidase reduces oxygen to water using four electrons.
text.zh-Hant: 最終電子受體。細胞色素氧化酶用四個電子把氧還原成水。
